messages:
Sam (AE): Hi team — Acme POC hitting intermittent 5xxs and throttling during synthetic load test. Root ts: 1715001234. They saw spikes around 15 rps. Can we swarm?
Maria (Support): Ack. Any request ids or logs? Are they getting 429 or 500?
Sam (AE): Mostly 500 and 503, sometimes 429. Sample error from client: "500 Internal Server Error - inference runtime: failed to allocate KV cache". Request ID x-req-id: req_0a1b2c3d
Devon (Oncall): Pulling logs now. @Nisha can you check autoscaler events for the dedicated pool used by this POC (pool: poc-acme-gpu)?
Nisha (Infra): Looking. Node utilization hit 98% GPU mem, pods started OOMKill on 2024-05-06T16:12:07Z. Autoscaler didn't add new nodes — minNodes=0, maxNodes=3, scaleUpCooldown=300s. Looks like we were rate-limited by cloud provider during scale-up.
Leo (Product): That minNodes=0 for a POC is risky. For sales demos we should recommend minNodes=1 to avoid cold-start throttling.
Maria (Support): Can you paste the failing log snippet?
Sam (AE): Paste:
```
ERROR runtime/infer.go:412: inference failed: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = runtime: allocation failed: unable to reserve 512MB for kv_cache
x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d
status: 500
```
Devon (Oncall): Also seeing 429s with header `x-rate-limit-reset: 30` on some calls — looks like we hit per-instance token concurrency limits and the routing fallback queued requests and then upstream returned 503 when cache cold-fill failed.
Nisha (Infra): Quick mitigation: decrease max_batch_tokens to 1024 and set circuit-breaker fallback to smaller model (redwood/small-llm) for the route. That reduces memory pressure.
Sam (AE): Customer on call in 20m. Any fast workaround we can apply from control plane?
Maria (Support): Yes — temporarily route POC to lower-capacity model variant and enable autoscale minNodes=1 for the pool. I can change rollout to 100% to variant and set minNodes now. Needs approval from infra.
Nisha (Infra): Approved. I'll set minNodes=1 and bump maxPodsPerNode to 6. Applying now.
deploy-bot: apply rollout -> route/poc-acme-model variant=small-llm scaleSet.minNodes=1
Devon (Oncall): After change, error rate dropped. Metrics: 5xx -> 1.2% from 18% in the last 10m. Keep monitoring for 30m.
Sam (AE): Thanks team — I'll update Acme and keep this thread open. Follow-up: propose docs update recommending minNodes=1 for POCs in sales runbook.
Leo (Product): I'll own the docs PR.
Maria (Support): Closing loop: collect final logs and timeline for postmortem if it recurs. Sam, can you share customer test script?
Sam (AE): Shared link to gist with their load script: https://gist.github.com/acme/poc-load
Sam (AE): thx :thumbsup:
